cards.name: This cycle (rows)
cards.sql: with actual as (select budget_month, category, coalesce(subcategory, '') as subcategory, currency, sum(case when direction in ('expense', 'reimbursement') then -amount end) as actual, count(distinct transaction_id) as n from ledger_entries where status = 'kept' and direction <> 'income' and category is not null and budget_month is not null group by budget_month, category, coalesce(subcategory, ''), currency), plan as (select budget_month, category, coalesce(subcategory, '') as subcategory, currency, sum(amount) as plan from plan_lines group by budget_month, category, coalesce(subcategory, ''), currency), joined as (select coalesce(p.budget_month, a.budget_month) as budget_month, coalesce(p.category, a.category) as category, coalesce(p.subcategory, a.subcategory) as subcategory, coalesce(p.currency, a.currency) as currency, p.plan, a.actual, coalesce(a.n, 0) as n from plan p full outer join actual a on p.budget_month = a.budget_month and p.category = a.category and p.subcategory = a.subcategory and p.currency = a.currency) select category as "Category", subcategory as "Subcategory", currency as "Currency", plan as "Plan", actual as "Actual", n as "Transactions" from joined where budget_month in (select budget_month from month_summaries where cycle_open) order by "Actual" desc nulls last, category, subcategory

cards.name: Where the money went
cards.sql: select category as "Category", sum(case when direction in ('expense', 'reimbursement') then -amount end) as "Actual" from ledger_entries where status = 'kept' and direction <> 'income' and category is not null and currency = 'UAH' and budget_month in (select budget_month from month_summaries where cycle_open) group by category order by "Actual" desc
